name: 'Setup node & pnpm via proto'
description: >-
  Installs node/pnpm from the calling repo's .prototools via proto, then
  optionally caches the pnpm store. Does not touch Rust -- pair with
  setup-rust separately in jobs that also need a specific cross-compile
  target, since a blanket proto rust install would conflict with it.
inputs:
  working-directory:
    description: 'Directory containing package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  cache:
    description: 'Whether to cache the pnpm store (skip for jobs that never run pnpm install)'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@v0
    - shell: bash
      run: proto install node && proto install pnpm
    - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-pnpm-cache@v1
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      with:
        working-directory: ${{ inputs.working-directory }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install the Rust target
        run: rustup target add "$TRIPLE"

      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-proto-node-pnpm@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          working-directory: ${{ matrix.packageDir }}
          cache: 'false'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # napi's --cross-compile links non-native Linux targets with cargo-zigbuild. This job holds id-token and
      # attestations: write, so the linker is pinned by version and wheel hash (x86_64 and aarch64 Linux runners).
      # Bump both together from the ziglang release page on PyPI.
      - name: Install zig
        if: matrix.useCross
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r /dev/stdin <<'REQS'
